newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.049pts to 103.260.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.049pts to 103.260.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.049 points in Thursday's trading to 103.260, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.054 points to 2.249 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.036 points to 99.556, points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.187 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 3.320 points to 1,034.018.
